[[Reindeer]] are friendly [[beast]]s found in the wilds of the [[Far Shiverpeaks]]. A herd of them will spawn on rare occasions on the eastern part of [[Jaga Moraine]]. They are very similar to [[caribou]], however unlike caribou they do not flee on approach. They are not tamable by [[rangers]].
